description: This file defines the EmployeeDistributionBySubunit class in the OrangeHRM project, which encapsulates data related to employee distribution across subunits, including counts and limits.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunit
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that holds information about employee distribution across organizational subunits, including subunit count pairs, employee counts, and limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the distribution data including subunit pairs, counts, and limits.

methods.name: getSubunitCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of subunit count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of 'other' employees outside specific subunits.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unassigned employees.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on subunit entries or display.

methods.name: getTotalSubunitCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of subunits considered.
